seq_consecutive.note: seq_consecutive s u v holds when u and v are adjacent entries of the raw sequence s, in either order: (u, v) or (v, u) occurs in zip s (behead s), equivalently [:: u; v] or [:: v; u] occurs contiguously in s. Prop codomain, symmetric, with no edge, path, uniqueness or distinct-endpoint premise: [::] and one-entry sequences relate nothing, [:: x; y] relates exactly x and y, a repeated adjacent entry relates a value to itself, the closing pair of a cyclic sequence is not consecutive unless also adjacent, and it is invariant under rev; consecutive entries of a MathComp path or of a packaged coq-graph-theory Path are related by its relation.
